dataset_title: Duc Giang Chemicals Annual Report 2024 Vietnamese prose crops
purpose: Exploratory Vietnamese OCR CER/WER screening on visually transcribed prose regions from the issuer's 2024 annual report.
reference_method: Manual transcription from rendered source PDF crops, visually checked against the source images by one reviewer.
reference_quality: Five prose crops from PDF page 9 (printed page 7) were transcribed and visually checked by one reviewer. No independent second review was performed.
limitations: All five crops come from one page of one annual report and are not independent document samples.
References have one reviewer and no independent second review.
Crops isolate prose and do not measure full-page reading order, layout detection, or table extraction.
The PDF pages are image-only/scan-like; physical scan provenance is unverified.
CER/WER measure recognition only. Resource measurements are comparable only on the same device and benchmark configuration.
